ModMetadata.Name: ScriptedScreens Html [StationeersLaunchPad]
ModMetadata.Author: Gruffuss
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]ScriptedScreens Html[/h1] [i]Write a console screen as a web page. Client-side only.[/i]
Adds an [b]html[/b] element to ScriptedScreens consoles: give it HTML, CSS and, if you like, JavaScript, and ScriptedScreens Vector draws it as sharp geometry at any size, in real game fonts. A page written from browser habit works as written.
[h2]Highlights[/h2] [list] [*] Flexbox and grid, gradients, shadows, borders, transforms, inline SVG, forms and tables [*] Live values from Lua bind by element id: text, CSS, show/hide or a live graph [*] CSS transitions and keyframes animate on the client, with no per-frame Lua [*] Buttons, inputs, sliders and selects report back to your Lua script [*] Page scripts get the DOM you expect: querySelector, innerHTML, events, timers, a 2D canvas [*] Every page runs on its own thread, so the game thread barely notices it [/list]
[h2]Getting started[/h2] The mod folder holds six examples that run on paste, three complete console mockups, a one-page QUICKSTART.md, the guide (README.md), the support list (SUPPORT.md) and the release history (CHANGELOG.md), also [url=https://github.com/Gruffuss/scripted-screens-html/tree/main/ScriptedScreensHtml]on GitHub[/url]. With StationeersLua installed, AI editors can read and search the same docs through its MCP server.
[h2]What's new in 0.2.0[/h2] [list] [*] Pages lay out and animate on their own threads with a built-in layout engine [*] More pages written for a browser render as written: fonts, subscripts, layered backgrounds [*] Docs, examples and mockups for AI editors through StationeersLua's MCP server [/list] Full history: [url=https://github.com/Gruffuss/scripted-screens-html/blob/main/ScriptedScreensHtml/CHANGELOG.md]CHANGELOG.md[/url].
[h2]Requirements[/h2] [list] [*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3666779631]ScriptedScreens[/url] (required) [*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3787517570]ScriptedScreens Vector[/url] (required, draws the page) [*] [url=https://github.com/Gruffuss/scripted-screens-fonts]ScriptedScreens Fonts[/url] (required, the typefaces) [*] [url=https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad]StationeersLaunchPad[/url] with [url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx]BepInEx 5.x[/url] [/list] Source: [url=https://github.com/Gruffuss/scripted-screens-html]github.com/Gruffuss/scripted-screens-html[/url] (MIT).
